learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge about chemistry in daily life, understand its place and importance, and be able to relate this knowledge to daily life.
Acquire knowledge about chemical natural phenomena in daily life, especially acid rain. Acquire knowledge about chemicals in cleaning products used in daily life.
Acquire knowledge about chemicals in food products. Acquire knowledge about chemicals in cosmetic and paint products.

Acquire knowledge about chemicals in the structure of medicines. Acquire knowledge about chemicals in plastic, glass, ceramic, and agricultural products. Acquire knowledge about chemicals in textile products.

Acquire knowledge about heavy metals, radiation, and alternative energy sources. Acquire knowledge about current topics related to chemistry in industry, petrochemicals, chemistry in engineering sciences, and chemicals in our lives. Students will use this theoretical knowledge acquired within the scope of this course.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Chemistry, The Language of Chemistry, Chemistry Everywhere, The place of Chemistry in Science Education and Applications of Chemistry
Chemicals in Health and Pharmaceutical Products
Chemicals in Cosmetic and Paint Products
Chemicals in Plastic, Glass, Ceramics, Cement, and Agricultural Products
Chemistry in Biological Systems and Medical Products
Heavy Metals, Radiation, and Alternative Energy Sources
Current Topics Related to Chemicals in Our Lives-1
Student presentations, Current Topics Related to Chemicals in Our Lives-2
